name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Smart input buffer that simulates your trajectory and only delays a click when it actually saves you.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Turn this off to disable the buffer completely.

normal-ticks.name: Buffer Strength
normal-ticks.description: Maximum delay for normal modes (cube, ball, UFO, robot, spider, swing). <cy>1 tick = 1/240s</c>, 4 ticks = 1 frame @ 60 FPS. <cr>0 = off</c>.

wave-ticks.name: Wave Buffer Strength
wave-ticks.description: Maximum delay for Wave and Mini Wave turns. <cy>1 tick = 1/240s</c>. <cr>0 = off</c>.

spam-guard.name: Spam Guard
spam-guard.description: Stops buffering during fast Wave spam so spam sections stay responsive. Single taps and normal turns stay fully buffered.

spam-interval.name: Spam Interval
spam-interval.description: Inputs closer together than this many ticks count as spam.

spam-streak.name: Spam Streak
spam-streak.description: How many rapid inputs in a row are needed before the guard kicks in.

lookahead-ms.name: Search Time Limit (ms)
lookahead-ms.description: Maximum time spent searching for a good delay on one click. Lower = smoother frame rate, higher = more thorough with big buffers.

scan-stride.name: Minimum Scan Step
scan-stride.description: Above 16 ticks, delays are tested in steps that grow with the delay (never smaller than this). Higher = faster, slightly less precise.

show-hud.name: Show Status Label
show-hud.description: Shows a small label with the current buffer values and how many times it saved you.

hud-corner.name: Label Position
hud-corner.description: Which corner of the screen the status label sits in.

debug-log.name: Debug Logging
debug-log.description: Writes every save to the Geode log. Only useful for troubleshooting.
